Market today: Inflation fears are back, and geopolitical tensions are adding to the jitters. This is hitting tech and chip names hard, especially those on margin.

Your holdings: SMCI (-17.19%), MUU (-27.3%), SOXL (-50.32%), and SPAL (-31.09%) are all flagged for attention. These leveraged ETFs and SMCI are taking a beating, and your margin amplifies the pain.

Watch: Keep an eye on AAPL's setup. It's the cleanest long signal from the scanner.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your downside risk in the leveraged names and SMCI.
plays: Trim MUU and SOXL if they break their current stops.
Consider trimming SMCI if it continues to fall.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
